full_text:
Addendum <Supreme Court Rule No. 2924, November 26, 2020>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Rules shall enter into force on January 1, 2021.
Article 2 (Transitional Measures)
The previous provisions shall apply to applications for perusal and copying of judgments received before these Rules enter into force.
